create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance to buffer observations, actions, rewards, and value predictions for PPO training
insert_rollout_data: insert step data including observations, actions, rewards, and masks into the RolloutStorage buffer

generate_recurrent_minibatches: generate shuffled mini-batches preserving temporal sequences for recurrent PPO policy updates
